gaps.sentence: Small suppliers are struggling to keep their heads ___ water.
gaps.explanation: 'Keep your head above water' = just manage to survive, especially financially.

gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
He decided to go ___ for the chess championship.
gaps.explanation: 'Go in for' = take part in a competition.

gaps.sentence: Come on, join ___ — it's easy once you start.
gaps.explanation: join in = take part in an activity others are doing.

gaps.sentence: Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: I can't figure ___ how this app works.
They live ___ their pension and a small rent.
gaps.explanation: live off = have as income/food; live on = have as income (money).
